_schema.note: Each category's 'resources' array holds objects with this shape. Filling the directory is just adding objects here — no other file needs to change.

resource.name: string — resource name
resource.country: string — one of: US, UK, EU, CA, AU, NZ, GLOBAL
resource.type: string — one of: website, tool, guide, dataset, organization, publication

resources.name: Consumer Federation of America

resources.description: Nonprofit with a full, free coding curriculum and certifications in web development, data and programming, a free alternative to expensive bootcamps.

resources.name: Class Central
resources.description: Search engine and reviews for online courses from universities and platforms, with curated lists of courses that are still completely free and how to avoid paying for certificates you don't need.

resources.name: Student Borrower Protection Center
resources.description: Nonprofit focused on student debt, with research and resources on student loan servicers, predatory schools and borrower rights.

resources.name: Save the Student
resources.description: Independent UK site on student money: student finance, budgeting, banking and avoiding scams, with free tools and practical guides written for students.

resources.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
resources.description: Free web publication of virtually all MIT course content, open to the world.

resources.name: OER Commons
resources.description: Digital library of free open education resources for teachers and students.

resources.name: OpenStax
resources.description: Free college textbooks for students, making education more affordable.

resources.name: Saylor Academy
resources.description: Free online courses, with the option to earn credit toward a degree.

resources.name: The Odin Project
resources.description: Free open-source curriculum for learning web development.

resources.name: Center for Auto Safety
resources.description: Nonprofit car safety advocacy group with free guides on recalls, defects and lemon laws, including a state-by-state ranking of lemon law protections.

resources.name: CarComplaints.com
resources.description: Independent database of owner-reported car problems by make, model and year, showing the most common defects, repair costs and worst model years before you buy.

resources.name: Consumers for Auto Reliability and Safety (CARS)
resources.description: Nonprofit auto safety and consumer group with resources on unrepaired recalls in used cars, dealer practices and car buyers' rights.

resources.name: US PIRG
resources.description: Nonprofit consumer watchdog with free consumer tips, product safety alerts and campaigns on right to repair, hidden fees and dangerous products.

resources.name: ScamAdviser
resources.description: Free website checker that gives an automated trust score for online shops based on domain age, ownership, hosting and user reports. A quick first check before buying from an unfamiliar store.

resources.name: CHOICE
resources.description: Australia's leading independent consumer organisation. Product testing, buying guides and campaigns against misleading pricing and unfair business practices.

resources.name: Ethical Consumer
resources.description: UK ethical consumer guide with independent product guides and research since 1989. Some content is paid.

resources.name: Fake Website Buster
resources.description: Scam website checker that flags risks such as fraud, phishing and spam.

resources.name: Open Beauty Facts
resources.description: Collaborative, free and open database of ingredients in cosmetic products.

resources.name: Open Products Facts
resources.description: Collaborative, free and open database of information on products from around the world.

resources.name: Truth in Advertising (TINA.org)
resources.description: US nonprofit that watches for deceptive advertising and keeps ads honest.

resources.name: Consumer Rights Wiki
resources.description: Community wiki that documents anti-consumer practices by companies and products: forced subscriptions, features removed after purchase, hidden fees and devices that stop working when servers shut down.

resources.name: Deceptive Patterns
resources.description: Long-running catalog of deceptive design tricks like hard-to-cancel subscriptions, sneaky add-ons and fake urgency, with real examples so you can recognize them before they cost you.

resources.name: Dark Patterns Tip Line
resources.description: Coalition project, backed by consumer and digital rights groups, where people report manipulative designs such as subscription traps and hidden charges. Reports are used for research and advocacy.

resources.name: Citizens Advice – Damaged, Lost or Delayed Parcels
resources.description: Step-by-step UK guide from the charity on who is responsible when a parcel is lost, damaged or late (usually the seller, not the courier) and how to get a refund or replacement.

resources.name: Which? – Delivery Rights
resources.description: Guidance from the UK consumer association on your rights when online orders arrive late, damaged or not at all, including template letters to claim from the retailer.

resources.name: 17TRACK
resources.description: Free universal package tracker covering thousands of carriers worldwide. Handy for international orders where tracking is handed between couriers, and for checking whether a 'delivery problem' text is genuine.

resources.name: EveryoneOn
resources.description: Nonprofit that helps low-income households find low-cost internet plans and affordable computers in their area, plus free digital skills training.

resources.name: NCLC – Utility Rights
resources.description: Resources from the National Consumer Law Center on utility shutoffs, payment plans and bill assistance programs, and what protections customers have when they fall behind.

resources.name: National Energy Action
resources.description: The UK's fuel poverty charity, with free advice on cutting energy bills, dealing with energy debt and accessing grants and support schemes.

resources.name: ACCAN
resources.description: Australia's peak body for phone and internet consumers. Free tip sheets on contracts, billing disputes, financial hardship and choosing a provider.

resources.name: Centre for Sustainable Energy
resources.description: UK charity with free energy advice to help people end cold homes.

resources.name: LibreSpeed
resources.description: Free and open source speed test you can run in your browser.

resources.name: OpenSpeedTest
resources.description: Free browser-based internet speed test, useful to check what your provider delivers.

resources.name: Public Interest Advocacy Centre
resources.description: Canadian not-for-profit and charity that protects consumer interests in regulated services such as telecom and energy.

resources.name: Surveillance Self-Defense (EFF)
resources.description: Free guides from the Electronic Frontier Foundation on protecting your privacy online: strong passwords, two-factor authentication, secure messaging and avoiding tracking.

resources.name: Privacy Guides
resources.description: Independent, nonprofit, community-run site with privacy and security recommendations for browsers, email, messaging and more. Explains the trade-offs instead of selling products.

resources.name: Have I Been Pwned
resources.description: Free service to check whether your email address or phone number has appeared in a data breach, with optional alerts for future breaches.

resources.name: Big Ass Data Broker Opt-Out List
resources.description: Community-maintained list of data brokers and people-search sites with direct opt-out links and instructions, prioritized by which ones matter most.

resources.name: Privacy Rights Clearinghouse
resources.description: Nonprofit privacy organization with consumer guides and a searchable Data Breach Chronology to check which companies have exposed customer data.

resources.name: noyb – European Center for Digital Rights
resources.description: Nonprofit led by Max Schrems that enforces GDPR through strategic complaints against big tech. Useful explainers on your data rights in Europe, such as access and deletion requests.

resources.name: Open Rights Group
resources.description: UK digital rights organisation campaigning on privacy, data protection and online surveillance, with explainers on how changes in the law affect your data.

resources.name: Am I Unique?
resources.description: Check whether your browser has a unique fingerprint and how identifiable you are online.

resources.name: Blacklight
resources.description: Real-time website privacy inspector from The Markup that shows the trackers a site uses.

resources.name: Cover Your Tracks
resources.description: EFF tool that shows how trackers see your browser.

resources.name: Derechos Digitales
resources.description: Latin American organisation defending digital rights and inclusive technology, with guides on privacy and online freedoms. In Spanish.

resources.name: Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF)
resources.description: Nonprofit defending civil liberties in the digital world, with privacy guides and tools.

resources.name: Exodus Privacy
resources.description: Non-profit that analyses Android apps for trackers and permissions.

resources.name: NOYB — European Center for Digital Rights
resources.description: Non-profit based in Vienna that enforces data protection rights by filing complaints against companies.

resources.name: Privacy Badger
resources.description: EFF browser extension that blocks trackers that follow you across the web.

resources.name: Privacy Guides
resources.description: Impartial non-profit outlet recommending privacy tools and explaining how to protect your data.

resources.name: Privacy International
resources.description: UK-based charity working on technology and rights, with guides on protecting personal data.

resources.name: PrivacySpy
resources.description: Open project that grades and monitors privacy policies.

resources.name: PrivacyTests
resources.description: Independent tests of the privacy protection offered by major web browsers.

resources.name: VirusTotal
resources.description: Free service that scans files and links for malware using multiple antivirus engines. Owned by Google.

resources.name: Webbkoll
resources.description: Tool that checks what data-protecting measures a website has taken.

resources.name: Dollar For
resources.description: Nonprofit that helps patients apply for hospital charity care, the free or reduced-cost care most US nonprofit hospitals must offer, and get medical bills reduced or wiped out at no cost.

resources.name: National Health Care for the Homeless Council
resources.description: Nonprofit network of health centers serving people experiencing homelessness. Its directory helps people find free or low-cost healthcare without needing an address or insurance.

resources.name: NeedyMeds
resources.description: Nonprofit database of patient assistance programs, free clinics and discount programs that help people afford their prescription medications.

resources.name: Undue Medical Debt
resources.description: Nonprofit, formerly RIP Medical Debt, that buys and forgives medical debt for people facing financial hardship. Explains how medical debt relief works and what to do if you receive a forgiveness letter.

resources.name: The Patients Association
resources.description: Independent UK charity with a free helpline and advice leaflets for patients navigating the NHS, from accessing treatment to making complaints about care.

resources.name: BenefitsCheckUp
resources.description: National Council on Aging tool to find benefits that help seniors pay for everyday needs.

resources.name: CancerCare
resources.description: Free cancer support services including counseling, support groups, workshops and financial assistance.

resources.name: Community Health Advocates
resources.description: Helpline and education for New Yorkers navigating the health care system and insurance problems.

resources.name: FAIR Health
resources.description: Nonprofit consumer site to estimate what medical and dental procedures cost in your area.

resources.name: Family Voices
resources.description: National network of families of children and youth with special health care needs, with health insurance guides.

resources.name: HealthWell Foundation
resources.description: Foundation that helps with copays, premiums and out-of-pocket costs for people with certain health conditions.

resources.name: Swiss Patient Organisation
resources.description: Swiss patient organisation advising on medical and dental treatment for 40 years. In German.

resources.name: Triage Cancer
resources.description: Free education on legal and practical issues for people with cancer, caregivers and professionals.

resources.name: Science-Based Medicine
resources.description: Independent blog written by physicians and scientists that evaluates health claims, supplements and alternative treatments against the evidence, with no products to sell.

resources.name: Examine
resources.description: Independent research summaries on supplements and nutrition, with no ads or sponsors. Free pages cover what the evidence says about each supplement; deeper analysis is a paid tier.

resources.name: CSPI – Dietary Supplements
resources.description: The Center for Science in the Public Interest, a nonprofit consumer watchdog, investigates misleading supplement marketing, contaminated products and weak regulation.

resources.name: Cochrane
resources.description: International nonprofit network producing systematic reviews of health treatments, with plain-language summaries anyone can read to see whether a treatment actually works.

resources.name: Sense about Science
resources.description: UK charity that helps the public question health and science claims. Its 'Ask for Evidence' campaign encourages people to challenge companies about the evidence behind their products.

resources.name: ConsumerLab
resources.description: Independent test results and reviews of vitamins, supplements and nutrition products. Paid subscription.

resources.name: Labdoor
resources.description: Sends supplements to an FDA-registered lab for purity and label accuracy tests and ranks the results.

resources.name: Feeding America – Find Your Local Food Bank
resources.description: The largest US hunger-relief network. Enter your ZIP code to find your local food bank, food pantries and free meal programs.

resources.name: Trussell
resources.description: UK charity supporting a network of more than a thousand food banks. Explains how to get a food voucher and find your nearest food bank, plus help with the money problems behind it.

resources.name: Foodbank Australia
resources.description: Australia's largest food relief organisation, supplying charities and school programs nationwide. Shows how individuals can find food help in their state.

resources.name: Mouse Print
resources.description: Long-running independent consumer site that exposes the fine print in ads and packaging, especially shrinkflation, where products get smaller while the price stays the same.

resources.name: FARE – Dining Out with Food Allergies
resources.description: Practical guidance from the nonprofit Food Allergy Research & Education on eating out safely: talking to restaurant staff, chef cards and what to do if a reaction happens.

resources.name: Allergy UK
resources.description: UK charity offering free allergy support and resources.

resources.name: AllergyEats
resources.description: Community-built restaurant guide for people with food allergies. Run by a company.

resources.name: Barnivore
resources.description: Guide to vegan beer, wine, cider and liquor.

resources.name: Coeliac UK
resources.description: UK charity with advice on coeliac disease and gluten-free living.

resources.name: Food Allergy Research & Education (FARE)
resources.description: Largest US private funder of food allergy research, with information for people living with food allergies.

resources.name: Gluten Free Watchdog
resources.description: Independent laboratory testing of gluten-free foods, with product reports. Part of the content is paid.

resources.name: Open Food Facts
resources.description: Collaborative, free and open database of ingredients and nutrition facts for food products.
